About Stone

Sinuous geometries, rounded forms and soft volumes are the design features of Stone, a bed with a large padded headboard designed by Federico Peri for Baxter. The inspiration is the Japanese Zen garden with its bevelled stones delicately arranged in the sand according to a precise principle of balance and harmony. The Stone bed consists of an extra-large modular headboard which, with its rounded edges, resembles a river stone smoothed by time and water. A solid element that gently contrasts with the softness of the leather upholstery. The modular nature of the headboard also makes it possible to adjust the heights and widths of its components, which can be accessorised with single-leg tables complete with integrated adjustable light. One touch and the magic is revealed: the table lights up!
